summary: adapter.py: deterministic TDD lifecycle adapter; REPOSITORY_ROOT parents[4], imports strict skill input gate and canonical evidence bytes; prepare requires backend.hidden_state=false, shell registry disabled, declared slice, nonempty contract_hash+validator_hash; preparation is non-authoritative and excludes acceptance/handoff/release; transition RED requires prepared, declared nonzero failure, test/docs-only paths; GREEN requires observed RED, success, production-only paths; REFACTOR requires GREEN, success, declared production/tests/docs paths; finalize candidate only exact red/green/refactor sequence; resume rejects identity mismatch and failed/stale/superseded runs; stage binding validates exactly one matching context/attempt, plan/slice/run IDs, STAGE-{RED|GREEN|REFACTOR}, empty authorization, returns hashes; protocol persistence validates bundle/store, containment, no symlink/reparse points, immutable matching existing evidence, strict artifact order, limited observation allowlist; execute rejects preexisting run, gates input, applies events, requires bundle/store together, persists recovery-state with identities/stages and optional skill binding hashes; potential ambiguity: execute creates run directory before later validation/block, leaving an existing directory that prevents reuse.
